events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, Abbey Road, in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road iconic status
angles.copy: It's 57 years since The Beatles gave us Abbey Road – an album that still defines an era. What's your top track from this legendary record?

events.title: Freddie Mercury would have been 80
events.blurb: Legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury was born in 1946 and would have been 80 today.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 today. His voice, his stage presence, his legacy – truly one of a kind.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' formidable lead singer Chrissie Hynde was born in 1951 and turns 75 today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde celebration
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and songwriting have given us some timeless rock anthems. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54

angles.name: Liam Gallagher birthday shoutout
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis or solo anthem?

events.title: Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal album 'Imagine' was released in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine album impact
angles.copy: 51 years ago, John Lennon gave the world 'Imagine'. More than just an album, it's a timeless message of peace and hope. What does it mean to you?

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple first introduced the revolutionary iPod portable music player in 2001.

angles.name: iPod nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? 25 years ago, Apple changed how we listened to music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day celebration
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, who's your favourite 007 and what's the ultimate Bond song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86

angles.name: John Lennon tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87

angles.name: John Cleese birthday humour
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From silly walks to classic comedy, what's your favourite moment from his incredible career?

events.title: "White Album" Anniversary

angles.name: White Album deep dive
angles.copy: It's 58 years since The Beatles unleashed the sprawling brilliance of the 'White Album'. Which track from this diverse double LP is your hidden gem?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the iconic frontman of Queen, passed away in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury remembrance
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Freddie Mercury today. His incredible talent and unforgettable performances continue to captivate. What's your favourite Queen live moment?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, was tragically killed in 1980.

angles.name: John Lennon remembrance
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon today, 46 years since his tragic passing. His music and enduring message of peace continue to live on.
